short: Playful term for running many AI coding agents in parallel and conducting them like an orchestra, rather than working with one at a time.
definition: Polyagentmorous is a playful, informal term — coined by OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger — for a way of working where you run many AI coding agents at the same time and act like an orchestra conductor guiding them, instead of chatting with a single agent one request at a time. In practice this can mean keeping several agents busy in a grid of terminals, each tackling a different task or racing at the same one, while the human sets direction and reviews the results. The name riffs on 'polyamorous,' half-jokingly capturing the shift from a one-on-one relationship with a single agent to juggling a whole team of them.
